overview: Close the remaining auth gaps: password reset link, Google social login, sign-up flow, and biometric authentication.

scopeCuts: Focus on auth parity inside mobile auth routes, hooks/store, and account client
Exclude server-side OAuth provider config, new server endpoints, enterprise SSO

prerequisites: Existing scaffold/auth/api client phases are already implemented in mobile/
AccountClient supports login, validateOtp, verify2fa, getUserWorkspaces, and social provider OAuth
expo-secure-store is already configured for token persistence
If TASK-004 is executed, biometric support must be added to mobile/package.json
contracts: OAuth redirect uses expo-auth-session or expo-web-browser
New auth routes stay under mobile/src/app/(auth)/**
Existing login/OTP/2FA flows must not regress

tasks.title: Add password reset / forgot password flow
tasks.description: Add a Forgot Password link on the login screen that triggers the server's password reset email flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Login screen shows a Forgot Password link below the password field that navigates to a reset screen.
Reset screen accepts an email, calls AccountClient's password reset method, and shows a confirmation message.
Invalid or unregistered emails show a user-friendly error without revealing whether the email exists.

tasks.title: Add Google social login
tasks.description: Add a Continue with Google button on the login screen using the server's existing OAuth provider configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Login screen shows a Continue with Google button that initiates an OAuth redirect via expo-auth-session.
Successful OAuth callback extracts the token and proceeds to workspace selection like email/password login.
OAuth failure or user cancellation returns to the login screen with a recoverable error state.

tasks.title: Add sign-up / create account flow
tasks.description: Add a sign-up screen accessible from the login screen for new users.
acceptanceCriteria: Login screen shows a Create Account link that navigates to a signup form (name, email, optional password).
Successful signup calls AccountClient signUp() and routes to email confirmation or workspace selection.
Duplicate email or validation errors show recoverable inline errors without losing entered form data.

tasks.title: Add biometric authentication (Face ID / Touch ID)
tasks.description: Add optional biometric unlock after initial login so returning users skip password entry.
acceptanceCriteria: After successful login, users are prompted to enable biometric unlock (opt-in, stored in expo-secure-store).
On app launch with valid stored token, biometric prompt appears; success proceeds to workspace, failure falls back to password.
Devices without biometric hardware skip the prompt entirely and fall back to standard login without error.

failureModes.recovery: Auth state stays on login screen; no partial auth state persisted
Show Resend button after 30s; suggest checking spam

failureModes.detection: Biometric succeeds but API rejects token
failureModes.recovery: Clear biometric enrollment and fall back to password login
Show inline error on email field, preserve other form data

testCoverageMap: TASK-001: reset email send + invalid email error + confirmation UI
TASK-002: OAuth redirect + callback token extraction + cancellation recovery
TASK-003: signup form validation + duplicate email error + confirmation routing
TASK-004: biometric enrollment + success/failure + no-hardware fallback
